output_name_hint: You can rename the file; output is saved as WAV
center_extraction_tip: Further emphasizes vocals located between the left and right channels, but narrows the stereo image; when off, only backing vocal removal runs
weak_vocal_protection_tip: When vocal emphasis is enabled, reduces the chance of attenuating a quiet live vocal; may preserve more centered content from the original recording
preview_empty: The output can be previewed here after processing
preview_error: Cannot play this audio; check the system audio backend
warn_no_song: Choose the stage / live audio first.
warn_no_acc: Choose the song source that matches the stage content.
warn_no_out: Choose where to save the output.
aligning: Synchronizing the stage / live audio and song source...
align_fail: Could not synchronize reliably; continuing at the original time position...
auto_found: Found a possible matching song source
auto_not_found: No matching song source was found; choose one manually
warn_invalid_parameters: The processing settings are invalid. Check them and try again.
warn_same_inputs: The stage / live audio and song source must be different files.
warn_output_conflict: The output must not overwrite the stage / live audio or song source.
home_intro: Use song sources to remove backing vocals from stage / live audio, or use AI to separate one audio file into vocals and background.
home_choose_hint: Choose Single for one stage and Full recording for a continuous show. Both modes need matching song sources.
home_mr_meta: Input: stage / live audio + song sources
home_mr_description: Single mode removes backing vocals directly; full-recording mode finds each song from multiple sources, then removes backing vocals section by section.
home_ai_description: Uses one audio file to create separate vocal and background tracks; the selected AI model downloads automatically on first use.
stage_output_hint: By default, saves the processed WAV next to the full recording
stage_sources_hint: Add every song source that may appear in the recording in any order; each song is found and placed by time automatically.
stage_timeline_hint: Uncheck anything you do not want to process; double-click a recording time or source range to correct it. Unmatched sections are preserved in full.
stage_ready: Choose the full recording and add song sources.
stage_need_sources: Add at least one song source.
stage_need_analysis: Find the songs first, then check the processing ranges.
stage_fingerprinting: Analyzing music in the full recording...
stage_analysis_done: Song detection complete; found {count} full songs.
stage_analysis_summary: Found {songs} full songs and {fragments} extra fragments; {missing} sources were not identified.
stage_manual_updated: Processing ranges changed; the output will use the current checks and time ranges.
stage_invalid_edit: Invalid time range format; use "minutes:seconds.milliseconds - minutes:seconds.milliseconds" and make the end later than the start.
stage_render_loading: Reading the full recording and preparing the output...
log_level_description: Controls how much runtime information the app and CLI record; use DEBUG when troubleshooting
update_check: Check for new versions at startup
update_unavailable: No update source is configured, so this feature is currently unavailable
ai_model_need_download: Download needed; it downloads automatically on the first extraction
mdl_kuielab_b: General-purpose model trained by the paper authors
ai_invalid_model: The selected model is not available; choose another.
ai_err_model_load: Could not load the AI model: {msg}
